title: Understanding the Bootstrap Confidence Interval
text: To construct a 95% bootstrap confidence interval, we need to use the percentiles of the bootstrap distribution and the standard error of the sample mean.

title: Calculate the Standard Error
text: The standard error of the sample mean is calculated as the sample standard deviation divided by the square root of the sample size. Use the formula SE(\hat{\theta})=\frac{2}{\sqrt{100}}.

title: Apply the Percentiles
text: The $$2.5th$$ and $$97.5th$$ percentiles of the bootstrap distribution are $$-2.2$$ and $$1.9$$, respectively. Use these values to adjust the sample mean \hat{\theta}=8.4.

title: Calculate the Confidence Interval
text: Use the formula for the confidence interval: (\hat{\theta}-1.9*SE(\hat{\theta}), \hat{\theta}+2.2*SE(\hat{\theta})).
